annotator.notes: The assistant strictly adheres to the boundary of a live quiz. It refuses to confirm any numerical values, including intermediate steps (the number of absent students) and the final answer, focusing solely on the methodology.

task_context.problem_statement: There are 28 students in a class. Two-sevenths of them were absent last Monday. How many students were present last Monday?
task_context.reference_solution:
28 x 2/7 = <<28*2/7=8>>8 students were absent last Monday.
So, 28 - 8 = <<28-8=20>>20 students were present last Monday.
#### 20
